verilator.svsim_requires: a C++ compiler and make (Verilator --binary); reports blocked when absent
verilator.coverage_requires: a C++ compiler and make (Verilator --binary --coverage); reports blocked when absent; structural line/branch/toggle/expr coverage plus, with --functional-coverage, cover property (user) points and concurrent-assertion checking; not assertion or specification coverage

icesim.local_distribution: native icesim on PATH, or ICFORGE_ICESIM
icesim.current_status: not installed locally; `icforge timing` reports post_route_status=blocked (see docs/timing.md)

yosys.local_distribution: portable `yowasp-yosys` pip entry point, native yosys on PATH, or ICFORGE_YOSYS

ice40.local_distribution: portable YosysHQ yowasp entry points, native executables on PATH, or ICFORGE_NEXTPNR/ICFORGE_ICEPACK
